notes.title: 🔴 LIVE: Unmourned – Psychological Horror Demo
notes.content:
[h3][i][u]Short Description[/u][/i][/h3][p]Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?[/p][p][/p][h3][i][u]GAMEPLAY:[/u][/i][/h3][p]Transition between reality and visions as you're forced to experience haunting memories. Each shift reveals disturbing events, bringing you closer to the tragic story that ties the haunting to the house.
[/p][h3][i][u]Mechanics:[/u][/i][/h3][p]Unmourned features a set of mechanics designed to heighten the tension and terror of your experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]Random Event System[/b]: Paranormal activities occur randomly throughout the house, ensuring no two experiences are the same. You never know what might happen next.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sanity System: [/b]The longer you remain in the dark, the more your grip on reality weakens. As your sanity fades, the paranormal activity around you grows stronger, bringing you closer to the edge of insanity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night Vision Camera:[/b] A camera equipped with night vision, helping you navigate dark areas and escape lurking threats.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Photographic Camera[/b]: When the lights go out, the only way to uncover hidden truths is through the lens of your camera. Use it to reveal what the darkness conceals.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Mark your calendars! [/h3][h3]Unmourned arrives on Steam on [b]Monday,[/b] [b]November 17, 2025[/b]![/h3][p][/p][p]We can’t wait for you to experience the terror![/p][p]🔔 [b]Wishlist[/b] now to get notified the moment the game is available.[/p][p]🎥 Check out the trailer and share the news with your friends.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for supporting us on this journey — your wishlists, feedback, and encouragement mean everything. The nightmare begins soon.

[/p][previewyoutube="eAgCorsBdmo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p]
